name: Slonks Merge Manager
description: The live merge manager for Slonks: it burns one same-level Slonk into another and averages their embeddings.
about:
## Role in the Slonks system

This is the active merge manager for the **Slonks** NFT (`0x832233ddb7bcffd0ed53127dd6be3f1aa5845108`). Merging picks a survivor token and burns a donor of the same merge level; their embeddings are averaged and the result is re-rendered. It is an authorized metadata updater on the NFT. It reads **SlopGameV2** (`0x76c61b6140600429f50de5ac987e41672047cc28`) as an active-state fallback, while SlopGameV2 reads this manager for base merge state.

This deployment predates a later merge manager (`0x3c60eff7b4aff33a3ad5f0b7c9c7d13ba80a422f`), which the current renderer queries directly. It remains in that manager's legacy-state chain and can still supply historical merge state.
risks: The Slonks NFT owner can replace the active and legacy state sources, changing fallback merge levels and embeddings
